info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Condor Battery Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the creation and management of detailed entries for Condor batteries within the catalog. It allows users to submit essential information about battery specifications, enhancing the catalog's accuracy and usability. Typical consumers include product managers and inventory systems that aim to maintain up-to-date records of battery offerings. By utilizing this API, businesses can streamline their product detail updates, ensuring that customers have access to the latest information.

post.summary: Create new details for a Condor battery
post.description: This operation allows you to create and submit new details for a specific Condor battery. Ensure that all required information is provided in the request body to successfully register the battery details.

requestBody.description: The request body for creating or updating details for the Condor battery. This body should include specific attributes related to the battery, enabling the server to process the request correctly.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning battery details.
